results.title: [2410.08554] Integrated adaptive coherent LiDAR for 4D bionic vision
results.content: # Title:Integrated adaptive coherent LiDAR for 4D bionic vision. View a PDF of the paper titled Integrated adaptive coherent LiDAR for 4D bionic vision, by Ruixuan Chen and 19 other authors. A bionic LiDAR that can mimic human-like vision by adaptively gazing at selected regions of interest within a broad field of view is crucial to achieve high-resolution imaging in an energy-saving and cost-effective manner. Using the dynamic zoom-in capability and the coherent FMCW scheme, we achieve a state-of-the-art resolution of 0.012 degrees, providing up to 15 times the resolution of conventional 3D LiDAR sensors, with 115 equivalent scanning lines and 4D parallel imaging. | Cite as: | arXiv:2410.08554 [physics.optics] |. |  | (or  arXiv:2410.08554v1 [physics.optics] for this version) |.
